caption:
You can check your credit reports for free, every week. ✅

Equifax, Experian and TransUnion all offer free weekly reports through the official free report site. Looking at your report does not hurt your score.

Spot a wrong account or an address you don't recognize? That's worth disputing, and disputing is free.

What's the strangest thing you've ever found on a report?
first_comment: Found anything odd on your report? Tell us what it was. 👇

card.headline: Check all 3 reports free, every week
card.sub: Checking your own report doesn't hurt your score
